input_binding.accepted_coordinates: positive integer requested H/M PATTERN_LIMIT, before execution; HF has no M stage
input_binding.conditional_m: M request is tied to the exact H prefix, not independent full-M
input_binding.requested_is_not_realized: PATTERN_LIMIT maps to set_atpg_limits -Pattern_count; generated #test_patterns remains a separate later observation. Equality is unproved.
input_binding.normalization: Freeze and authenticate the entire roster SHA and its maxima before selecting any top-k; a subset must not reset the denominators.
input_binding.outcome_fields: Rejected in request schema, including generated h_patterns/m_patterns, F count, D95, cycles and runtime
input_binding.safety: New actions are not preverified safe under the old model contract; final F verification does not retroactively authenticate model admission.
input_binding.checkpoint_compatibility: Not established. No legacy feature vectors or model orders are emitted.
input_binding.identity_pins: Supplied digests are not byte authentication. Fault-manifest SHA cannot replace fault-body identity.

process_observation.kind: pure event validation only, no process launch or live memory guard
process_observation.limit_scope: Validator container bounds only; 64 is not an approved real ATPG attempt budget.
process_observation.clock_identity: same host and boot, observed PID plus process start ticks; monotonic timestamps must be comparable
process_observation.cost_scope: launch-observation to reap-observation includes dispatch/reap overhead; not create_patterns-only time, exclusive kernel time, old-ledger atomic duration or full online end-to-end cost
process_observation.incomplete: Missing or unverified reap returns null complete total, never configured-timeout substitution or zero cost
process_observation.failure: Observed failed, timeout and cancelled intervals are charged, not dropped
process_observation.tree_termination: A supplied termination_verified flag is an assertion, not an OS-authenticated process-tree proof. Actual runner must independently establish it before another launch.
process_observation.legacy_ledger: Do not copy these observation intervals into the E65 atomic ATPG cost node. A versioned real adapter and explicit timing bridge remain required.
